limitations_and_boundaries: Fiber length was not an independent prognostic factor in EAC after multivariate adjustment.
Fiber alignment showed only a trend toward significance in CRC (p=0.067).
The study is retrospective and uses tissue microarrays; validation in larger prospective cohorts is needed.
The in vivo model used a single HNSCC cell line (5PT) and fibroblast line (HFFF2); generalizability to other tumor types and CAF populations requires further study.
